name: Yokies
overview: This animated series features a family of egg-shaped aliens who crashed to Earth, namely Egof, Egstein, Egie, Evira, Papa Yokies and Mama Yokies. Each episode features unique adventures and conflicts that they have to face with perseverance and patience. Thanks to their burning perseverance and patience, they were finally able to overcome it, and were also infused with noble values that can be taken as a lesson by the audience.
